executionPlan: Standard-profile light QA: ran typecheck, lint, test and a copy-tree production build myself, verified the diff scope and the TalkingAvatar guard, then ran the production build on a private port with reused CDP harnesses plus two new probes (Cancel path, hero layout restore) at host load 20-43; stopped the server by exact PID and removed build copy and Chrome profiles.
summary: All five criteria pass with first-hand evidence on the production build: gates green (635 tests, / 125 kB), page inert and every failure row recovers to a usable portfolio with focus on Play, p95 16.8 ms, cold click swap 710-756 ms (report 709), 0 idle freezes, 0 game requests while browsing, M4 findings fixed, axe 0 violations, loop, camera sweep, Exit layout and touch intact. Approve for M5 commit. Findings are low: partial cold-load gain (known limitation) and a decelerating heap creep (about 0.04 MB per cycle by cycle 15, listeners flat).

criteria.criterion: Performance claims spot-checked by QA on the production build with host load recorded: rAF p95 under 17.5 ms walking the campus at 1440x900; Play to playable on a cold click is not slower than the report's figure by more than 20 percent; the hero stays free of freezes over 50 ms while idle after a Play hover; no main-thread work or game assets are fetched on ordinary portfolio browsing; heap and listener counts do not grow monotonically over 5 Play and Exit cycles. QA judges whether the partial cold-load gain (about 600 ms of the targeted 1.1 s) is acceptable and records it as a finding or a known limitation.
criteria.evidence: Host load 20-43 throughout (never quiet; recorded per run). perf.mjs 1440x900 real GPU (perf.log): 3119 frames over 52 s, p50 16.7, p95 16.8, p99 16.8, max 16.8 ms, 0 frames over 20 ms (load 30.5 to 22.9). Cold click (ab.mjs evalclick, fresh profile each, load 25-26): click to game swap 710, 713, 756 ms vs the report's 709 ms (limit 851 ms); click to Game started 2232, 2247, 2279 ms. Hover only, 6 s idle (2 runs, load 26 and 30): 0 long tasks over 50 ms and 0 rAF gaps over 40 ms. bytes.mjs: 70 requests while browsing and scrolling the whole page, browsingGameLike [] (no game chunk, clips or textureWorker); first play 944,993 B gzip, 13 requests. cycles.mjs N=5 and N=15: listeners 480 / jsListeners 505, DOM nodes 453, geometries 19, textures 66, programs 47 constant from cycle 1 to 15, focus on Play every cycle. Heap (after GC) 11.5 baseline, 17.19 after cycle 1, then 17.55, 17.76, 17.84, 17.95 ... 18.58 at cycle 15: increments shrink from 0.36 to about 0.04 MB per cycle, so heap is not flat over 5 cycles (+0.76 MB) but decelerating and bounded; listener counts do not grow. Judgement: the partial cold-load gain (about 600 ms of 1.1 s; 710 ms swap vs 1311 ms base per dev A/B) is acceptable as a recorded known limitation, not a blocker: the click still hands over in under 0.8 s on a load-30 host and it is a strict improvement with 0 hero freezes; heap creep is a low finding.

assumptions: FINDING F1 (low, owner game-dev, known limitation, not blocking): cold-load gain is about 600 ms of the 1.1 s target (swap 1311 -> 710-756 ms); press and hover gains are smaller. Revisit in M6 only if the Boss wants more.

FINDING F2 (low, owner game-dev, M6): heap after GC keeps creeping across Play/Exit cycles (17.19 MB at cycle 1 to 18.58 MB at cycle 15, increments shrinking 0.36 -> ~0.04 MB); listeners, DOM nodes, geometries, textures and programs are constant, so no app-object leak is shown, but strict 'not monotonic' is not met; a 50-cycle plateau check belongs in M6 deep QA.

FINDING F3 (info, owner product-designer/game-dev): failure dialog buttons read '[ retry ]' and '[ back to portfolio ]' rather than the design wording; clear and consistent with the terminal style, no functional impact, not blocking.
FINDING F4 (info, owner boss): untracked .company ADR-001..006 and task records are not source and were not in report 35's list; decide at commit time whether they ship with M5.

Host load was 20-43 during all timings, never quiet; hero-gap and p95 figures are therefore conservative. No physical phone; touch checked in CDP emulation only. Mutation-testing the inert and no-WebGL guards was not run (smoke-level reliance on the failures.mjs behavioural evidence, including the dev's documented pre-fix blank page).
